Digital Marketing & Direct Bookings

Hotel Meta Ads in India

Use stay campaigns to drive date-specific bookings and separate Meta lead campaigns to qualify events.

Discuss your project

Separate stays from event leads

Run stay offers against date-specific landing pages. For events, ask for date, city and guest count, then route realistic enquiries promptly to a venue contact.

Rotate creative deliberately

Test a room walkthrough, short itinerary and offer-led image with clear usage rights. Look at the quality and response time of leads before scaling.
